pages.title: The Winged Generation
pages.text: The insect’s native lifecycle supplies an elytra-upgrade material.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Spider eyes tame and flowers heal. Fermented eyes breed tames around prey; offspring emerge through a buried parasitized spider. Wings upgrade Elytra armor/durability, never a substitute reward.

pages.title: Practical note
